evidence_quote: The Canadian male patient of British ancestry and from a consanguineous first cousin marriage died aged 62 years, having undergone splenectomy when aged 38 years, tonsillectomy in childhood and enlargement of nose and earlobes in his late 40's.
note: Single patient with clinical case report and corneal pathology; no variant reported.

evidence_quote: Sequence analysis of the ABC1 gene revealed that the proband for Tangier disease was homozygous for a deletion of nucleotides 3283 and 3284 (TC) in exon 22.
note: Two affected homozygous siblings (VII-1, VII-2); obligate heterozygote parents not counted.

evidence_quote: DNA analysis revealed a new null mutation (C2033A) in both alleles, causing a premature stop codon at the amino acid residue 573, which resulted in truncation of the ABCA1 protein.
note: Counted the 3 homozygotes; 2 heterozygotes labelled 'hTD' by lipids only (unclear per task) not counted; only the proband genotyped.
